'''Polyskin''' was a type of artificial material. In [[3645 BBY]], [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces put up a polyskin tent over the remains of a crashed [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Warship/Legends|warship]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]. However, the tent was destroyed when the hulk exploded as a result of a gas leak.
